verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated GitHub CI integration page. It says GitHub Actions can run the official `s0` CLI non-interactively for image build/push, template updates and sandbox orchestration. The official CLI is confirmed at github.com/sandbox0-ai/s0, and SDK-driven use (OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain Deep Agents) adds programmatic, headless operation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and documentation for CI systems beyond GitHub Actions.
